method: native-resolution WMTS tiles (no resampling by the server), palette colours mapped back to the class value of the layer's GIBS colormap v1.3 (exact match, else within 2/255, else - for blends GIBS made while reprojecting a coloured image - interpolated along the palette ramp within 3 grey levels); colours with candidate values > 2 K apart (the clean-IR palette has two grey ramps) take the candidate nearest the mean of unambiguous pixels in a 9 x 9 window
encoding: 8-bit grey PNG; k=0 missing; value = lo + (k-1)*(hi-lo)/254
grid: regular lat/lon EPSG:4326 0.02 x 0.02 deg (same box and size as ciaran_modis_aqua_truecolour_2023-11-02.jpg), row 0 = 70 N edge, col 0 = 50 W edge, nearest neighbour from the 0.0176 deg tiles
